description: Angular component for a dialog to add and configure device profiles, including form handling, stepper navigation, and interaction with device profile service.

classes.name: AddDeviceProfileDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for the add device profile dialog, managing form steps, data binding, and submission.

methods.name: deviceProfileTransportTypeChanged
methods.description: Updates transport configuration based on selected transport type.

methods.name: previousStep
methods.description: Navigates to the previous step in the stepper.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step or triggers add operation if on last step.

methods.name: selectedForm
methods.description: Returns the current form group based on selected index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Validates forms, constructs device profile object, and saves via service.

methods.name: getFormLabel
methods.description: Returns label string for each step index.

methods.name: changeStep
methods.description: Handles step change event, updates UI state.

methods.name: maxStepperIndex
methods.description: Calculates maximum index of stepper steps.

methods.name: allValid
methods.description: Checks if all form steps are valid.
